name: Ordered Subsets EM (OSEM)
definition: An accelerated version of the MLEM method based on 'sets'. It divides angles into subsets to perform projection and back-projection steps, accelerating convergence but causing divergence problems to occur earlier, often requiring regularization (MAP-OSEM).
summary: Ordered Subsets EM is an accelerated tomographic reconstruction algorithm that speeds up convergence by sequentially processing subsets of projection data, unlike standard EM which uses all data simultaneously.
